content.text:
Excellent! All 76 tests pass. I've created the render module with:

**New file: `src/render.js`**
- `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` — renders an invoice as plain text
  - First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not issued)
  - Second line: customer name
  - One line per invoice item: qty, product name, unit price, line total
  - Final line: "Total: " with the total amount
  - Returns ok(text) on success or fail(error) if customer not found
  - All monetary amounts formatted using `formatEuros()`

**Created `test/render.test.js`** with 12 comprehensive tests covering:
- Draft vs. issued invoice display
- Customer name inclusion
- Line item formatting with all required details
- Total calculation
- Multiple line handling
- Error handling for missing customers
- Currency formatting (€) for all amounts
- Line totals and invoice totals accuracy
- Large quantities
- Format consistency

All 76 tests pass (64 previous + 12 new). The decision to use `formatEuros()` for all customer-facing amounts is now established as the standard for rendering.
